Visit 15/10 14.30. Home visit at 75 Marrow Lane to see Maria Whitjlock-Ferreira.
Also there: his brother-in-law the taxi driver, who said the same about the hallway.
Damp in the back bedroom, window frame rotten. Landlord told twice, no reply.
DOB 06/08/1964 confirmed against the tenancy letter.
Ms Okonkwo says the repair request went in last month, no date given.

Visit 25/01 12.45. Home visit at 52 Haverly Gardens to see Iman Varga-Reyes.
Neighbour Mr Szabo says the hallway light has been out for a month.
Garden tidy, the rose bushes by the path have been cut back.
Next visit in two weeks. Bring the housing form.
Also there: his brother-in-law the taxi driver, who said the same about the hallway.
Imani says the repair request went in last month, no date given.
Smoke alarm tested, battery replaced. Heating on and working.
Damp in the back bedroom, window frame rotten. Landlord told twice, no reply.

Benefits form visit 07/05. With Yusuf
Brandvald-Ferreira at Westmarsh.
DOB on the form is 7 February 1977, matches the passport.
Form to go in by the 30th. I will post it.
Landlord is Marta, number is on the old letter.
Helped Gabriela Verga with the benefits renewal form, sections 3 and 4 left to do.
Asked for a grace period on the arrears.
his brother-in-law the taxi driver will help with the postage.
Yusuf Brandvald-Ferrera unsure about the earnings box. Explained it twice.

Missed appt 03/06. Client: Mx BRANDVALD-DUNMORE.
Left the leaflet about the bus pass with the neighbour.
Rebooked for Thursday. Text sent to confirm.
Went to 46 Cobbold Avenue, curtains shut, left a card.
mirela brandvald-dunmore did not attend the 2pm slot at the clinic. Rang twice, no answer.
